biggest_catch: The catalog's '$2-$10 per module' quiz figure doesn't match anything current: Bybit's live official program is the Learn & Trade Growth Hub, an onboarding challenge series paying up to 80 USDT (new users) / 30 USDT (existing users) across multi-level Learn Challenges — and Bybit does not serve US residents.
catches: Bybit is not available to US residents — the catalog's 'US availability varies' is wrong for the US audience.
The Learn & Trade Growth Hub is an onboarding program (account activation, trading concepts, platform features across Levels 0-4), not a pure 'watch a video, take a quiz, get $5' module format.
Rewards 'may also include bonuses, points, and other incentives' per the official announcement — not all rewards are withdrawable cash; some are trading bonuses/coupons.
Rewards are denominated in USDT; crypto portions carry volatility and platform-specific terms.
Bybit AI feedback campaign (50 USDT, up to 500 winners, until Oct 9, 2026) and Quests challenge (25 USDT for top 40 scorers) are separate limited promos, not guaranteed quiz payouts.

c1.evidence: Bybit is a real operating exchange (bybit.com, second-largest by volume per the announcement).

c2.evidence: Bybit's own official announcement (April 16, 2026, distributed via Chainwire): 'Learn & Trade Growth Hub' — an evergreen onboarding initiative with Learn Challenges and USDT rewards, launched April 13, 2026.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee — Learn Challenges are free to complete once registered.

c4.evidence: Official announcement: 'New users may earn up to 80 USDT upon completing all Learn Challenges, while existing users may earn up to 30 USDT through participation.'

eligibility: Bybit account with identity verification, in a supported region (US residents are excluded — Bybit does not serve the US). New users unlock the full up-to-80 USDT track; existing users up to 30 USDT.

steps: Register a Bybit account and complete identity verification (US residents cannot use Bybit).
Find the Learn & Trade Growth Hub in the Bybit app or site and enroll.
Work through the Learn Challenges from Level 0 (Explorer, account activation) through Level 3 (Strategist), earning badges at each level.
Claim your rewards as you complete each level — new users can earn up to 80 USDT total, existing users up to 30 USDT.
At Level 4 (Master), enter the Weekly Reward Hub for ongoing activities and incentives.
timing: Rewards distributed upon successful completion of eligible challenges; Growth Hub is an evergreen (permanent) program launched April 13, 2026. Separate limited promos: Bybit AI feedback (until Oct 9, 2026), Bybit Quests quiz (until Sep 20, 2026).
